description: This Kotlin source file defines the MainActivity class for an Android app. The class manages the main user interface for a grocery shopping app, including setting up a bottom navigation bar to switch between Product List and Cart fragments. It handles fragment transactions based on navigation selections and initializes the default view.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that hosts the main UI of the app, managing bottom navigation and fragment transactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout and theme, configures bottom navigation item selection, and loads the default fragment.

methods.name: openFragment
methods.description: Replaces the current fragment with the specified fragment in the container.
